queries: site.anthropic.com February 24 2026 responsible scaling policy pledge pause
Anthropic core safety pledge February 2026 walked back responsible scaling policy

sources_considered.why: Dated primary announcement explaining the February 24 revision and its nonbinding safety goals.
Preceding policy version establishes the earlier safeguards and training restrictions.
Version 3.0 establishes the revised framework and the narrower pause commitments that remained.
Used to locate dated policy versions. The changing index is unnecessary as outcome evidence.
Read the full report and executive interview as a cross-check. Primary documents suffice for the assessment.

evidence_items.locator: Version 2.2, section 6.2, Monitoring pretraining, printed page 11
evidence_items.explanation: The preceding policy imposed training restrictions when required security safeguards were unavailable. This establishes the earlier commitment for comparison; its effective date precedes the target period.

evidence_items.locator: Updating our Responsible Scaling Policy, subsection 2: Frontier Safety Roadmap
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic explicitly made its roadmap goals nonbinding. The announcement explains that it was restructuring the earlier safeguards framework and separating achievable company plans from more ambitious industry recommendations, supporting a material weakening of the earlier pledge.

evidence_items.locator: Version 3.0, Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors, printed page 16; see also Introduction and sections 2–3
evidence_items.explanation: The revised policy retained commitments to delay development under specified conditions involving Anthropic's lead or competitors' safety measures, and added reporting obligations. This limits the finding to a weakened central pledge; it does not support a claim that all safety obligations disappeared.
